write_replaygain_tags.label: Write REPLAYGAIN_TRACK_GAIN tags back to files
write_replaygain_tags.description: When the background audio-analysis scan produces a loudness measurement, also write the corresponding REPLAYGAIN_TRACK_GAIN tag back into the audio file. Useful if other apps on your network read these tags for their own volume normalization. Requires write access to the file; read-only files are silently skipped.

manifest.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness measurement used for volume normalization.
